subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A sprinkler system waters a lawn at a rate of $2.7$ cubic meters per hour. What is this rate, in cubic centimeters per second? ($1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters)
explanation: Choice A is correct. Since $1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters, $1$ cubic meter $= 100^3 = 1{,}000{,}000$ cubic centimeters. Convert to cubic centimeters per hour: $2.7 \times 1{,}000{,}000 = 2{,}700{,}000$. Convert hours to seconds ($1$ hour $= 3{,}600$ seconds): $\frac{2{,}700{,}000}{3{,}600} = 750$ cubic centimeters per second.
